exact_statement: For every n>=2, nonempty Boolean negative support U of mass p, and partition into labels with no cross-labelled physical cube edge, set w(v)=P[f(X)!=f(X+v)], gamma(v)=P[X,X+v in U with distinct labels], ell=w+2gamma, I0=I(f). Let M0 be minimum ordinary-cost vector-basis sum and lambda0(v)=min{t:v in span{z:w(z)<=t}}. Then min over input bases B and marked v in B with ell(v)>=p of [sum_B w+2gamma(v)] equals M0+tau0, tau0=min_{ell(v)>=p}[ell(v)-lambda0(v)], with empty minimum infinity. Thus a reset and singleton meeting W>=p/2 and2gamma(v)<=rho-u exist iff M0+tau0<=I0-u, for any retained old debit u>=0. They pay L<=C(w(v)+rho-u), C=4+2/ln2+4/(e ln2), retaining all actual terminal entropies. This is an exact frontier for the stated sufficient interface mechanism, not for entropy-payment necessity. The all-crossing-labelled analogue has minimum M+tau, tau=min_{ell(v)>=p}(ell(v)-lambda(v)), and M0+tau0<=M+tau, strictly for actual Boolean support{1,2} in three bits with nonzero L=2 and old debit1/2. Genuine least-essential-dimensional positive K-witnesses at K>=C cannot satisfy the criterion with u=0. Original coordinate restrictions retain admissible inherited labels. Output characters, universal critical-source selection and full FEI are not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform cube n>=2; entropy bits; nonempty sign support, and inherited labels have no cross-labelled physical edge before reset
Invertible INPUT affine changes only; no output-character multiplication
Old debit u is retained; both complete actual restriction terminals and all earlier siblings remain in their signed ledger
Critical exclusion uses genuine least-essential-dimensional positive K-violation, K>=C; it is not inferred from weak ratio criticality
